title: [Shopify] Add Companies to Shopify navigation menu
summary: The Shopify Companies list is now accessible from the Shopify navigation group in the Business Manager, Order Processor, and Sales & Relationship Manager role centers, with a new Companies action placed after Customers.
key_points: Companies action added to Shopify navigation menu in three role centers
Action opens the Shopify Companies page using the Company icon
Companies are now directly accessible alongside Customers, Products, and Orders
Fixes missing Companies entry in Shopify menu
quote: Shopify Companies was missing from the Shopify navigation menu, forcing users to search for it manually.
